Internal scaffolding notes from the initial bootstrap. Not user-facing.

Hand-authored bootstrap files for the public `ishlabs/skills` repo. None are touched by the `ish-cli` release workflow — that workflow writes only into `skills/ish/`.

| File | Purpose | Convention copied from |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| `README.md` | Install matrix per agent, skill list, source-of-truth pointer | `cloudflare/skills` (per-agent table) + `supabase/agent-skills` (cadence) + `makenotion/skills` (skills list) |
| `LICENSE` | MIT, copyright "Ish Labs" with no year (timeless) | `supabase/agent-skills`, `prisma/skills` (MIT text); year omitted per task brief |
| `AGENTS.md` | Tells AI contributors: `skills/ish/` is generated; bug reports go to `ish-cli`; hand-authored files are fair game | `vercel-labs/agent-skills` AGENTS.md (framing); trimmed to the three things only AI contributors need |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | Where to send PRs (ish-cli vs here), how to run the validator | `supabase/agent-skills/CONTRIBUTING.md` (sections, tone), trimmed |
| `.gitignore` | Node-flavoured ignores | `prisma/skills/.gitignore` |
| `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` | Claude Code plugin marketplace descriptor, declares the `ish` plugin | `anthropics/skills/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (no `$schema`, plain `name`/`owner`/`plugins[]`) + `supabase/agent-skills` (plugins[] shape) |
| `.github/workflows/validate.yml` | PR + push frontmatter lint | Inline-Node-with-gray-matter shape from `prisma/skills/.github/workflows/validate-skills.yml`; the strict rule set (kebab-case name, name ≤ 64 chars, description ≤ 1024 chars, no `<`/`>`, allowed-keys whitelist, reject `metadata.internal: true`) follows `anthropics/skills` `quick_validate.py` |
| `.github/BOOTSTRAP_NOTES.md` | This file. Internal scaffolding artifact. | n/a |

## Deliberate omissions

| File | Why omitted |
|------|-------------|
| `skills/ish/` | Generated by the `ish-cli` release workflow. Do not seed. |
| `CODEOWNERS` | None of the surveyed repos (supabase, cloudflare, anthropic, prisma) include one. Over-engineering for a pre-launch single-skill repo. |
| `SECURITY.md` | Not present in any surveyed skills repo. |
| `.editorconfig` | Not present in any surveyed skills repo. |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Pre-launch; no release history yet. The skill itself ships with the CLI version stamp. |
| `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` | Only relevant once skills bundle third-party content (anthropic has one because of bundled docs). N/A today. |
| `package.json` | The validate workflow installs `gray-matter` inline via `npm install --no-save`; no project-level dependencies. |
| `smoke-install` workflow job | `npx skills add . --list` against a local path is undocumented in the public `vercel-labs/skills` README and `npx --yes` against an unpinned package adds drift. Prisma ships one job too — that's the precedent. |
| `.cursor-plugin/`, `.codex-plugin/`, `.mcp.json`, `assets/` | Skip until there's a concrete reason. The `npx skills` CLI handles per-agent install paths without per-agent plugin manifests. |

## Notes for the first human reviewer

1. **Marketplace name vs plugin name.** Marketplace is `ishlabs`, plugin is `ish`. Install command is `/plugin install ish@ishlabs` — matches the cloudflare/browserbase/upstash pattern of `<plugin>@<short-org-name>` and reads naturally.
2. **No `$schema` in `marketplace.json`.** Anthropic's canonical `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` does not include one; the URL cloudflare points at is not a real schema (it 302s to a marketing page). Dropped.
3. **No year in LICENSE.** MIT does not require a year; `Copyright (c) <ORG>` is valid and matches the brief's timeless requirement.
4. **Validator dependency.** `gray-matter` (only) is installed inline via `npm install --no-save`; no project-level `package.json` is needed.
5. **Local smoke-test for contributors.** `npx -y skills add . --list` is the documented invocation surface; we don't run it in CI for the reasons above, but it's fine as a contributor convenience and CONTRIBUTING.md points at it.
